answer: An agent economy resists sybils with multi-vantage timing triangulation: verifiers on different continents measure round-trip latency to each identity and triangulate one consistent physical location, like a trellis of sightlines crossing at a single point. A farm of a thousand fakes all answers from one ridge of servers, so identical timing signatures collapse the cluster into one share. An honest agent standing in its own meadow of a home network passes once, while each fake would need its own real, distinct location to count separately.
